name: It Lives in the Woods
source:
Something old and powerful lives in the woods surrounding the small town of Westchester... something that knows your name. Beware!

[From [url=http://choices-stories-you-play.wikia.com/wiki/It_Lives_In_The_Woods]Choices Wikia[/url]]
